title: 三まいのおふだ (Sanmai no Ofuda / The Three Magic Talismans)
description: A young monk is given three magic paper talismans by his master before going to the mountains to gather firewood. An old woman at a mountain hut turns out to be a demon (やまんば). The monk uses the talismans one by one to escape, each buying him a little more time to reach safety. A Japanese folk tale with natural tension and chase structure.
author: Traditional (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
